worldcombat.skill.wrap.summary: A ring of long body or vines wraps the target head to foot and squeezes: the hit pins it in place and crushes the strength out of its blows. The coil tightens on its own, so you can walk away once it is on. The target can only wait it out, or be torn open by a strong shove.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.use.0: Pin a dangerous target and crush its attack
worldcombat.skill.wrap.use.1: Hold a target in place for an ally
worldcombat.skill.wrap.use.2: Grind down a stubborn melee target with the coil alone
worldcombat.skill.wrap.description.0: Whips vines out to wrap one target within %2$s blocks with a %3$s block grip radius, dealing about %1$s contact damage as it catches.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.description.1: The coil clings to the target on its own for %1$s and squeezes every %2$s, so you can walk away once it lands; while it holds, the target is pinned in place and cannot move, and its Attack drops by %3$s stages. That Attack drop is not lifted with the coil and lasts until the target leaves combat.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.description.2: Pushing the target past %1$s blocks per tick tears it open.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.cocoon.on: Cocoon form: the coil lasts longer, squeezes harder, crushes another Attack stage and is harder to tear, but squeezes less often with a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.cocoon.off: Quick form: squeezes often with a short cooldown to press one round fast, but lasts less long and crushes less.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.growth.0: At level %1$s, Wrap power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.growth.1: At level %1$s, Wrap power rises to %2$s, the coil to %3$s and the Attack crush to %4$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.preference.cocoon: On: the coil lasts longer, squeezes harder, crushes another Attack stage and is harder to tear, but squeezes less often with a longer cooldown. Off (quick form): squeezes often with a short cooldown to press one round fast, but lasts less long and crushes less.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of whipping the vines. The move pins at close range, so larger values mostly invite whiffs while chasing.
worldcombat.skill.wrap.preference.ai.pre: On: targets at higher health and those attacking it come first - pin them down for allies. Off: it only orders by threat and distance.
